Claim 1 (Currently amended): A loading ramp, said loading ramp comprising: a support structure having a mounting member, said mounting member being compatible with a truck having a bed such that said support structure is adapted to be removably mounted to the truck; a first gradient member secured to said support structure, said first gradient member defining a first surface, a proximate end, and a distal end, the proximate end being opposite the distal end with respect to the first surface, the proximate end being proximate the bed of the truck when said support structure is mounted to the truck, the first surface being structured to support a small vehicle, wherein said first gradient member is a single continuous member.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein said loading ramp makes available storage space provided by the truck otherwise occupied when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck, and wherein said storage space is defined as the area above the truck bed.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 2 wherein said loading ramp supports at least a portion of the small vehicle when said loading ramp and the small vehicle are carried by the truck, and wherein said portion of the small vehicle is defined as the front or rear wheels.

Claim 8 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a plurality of beams arranged in a parallel configuration.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the first surface defined by said first gradient member includes a solid surface that is non-slip.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a mechanical device, said mechanical device moving said first gradient member between the up position and down position.

Claim 20 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 further comprising a locking member, said locking member locking said first gradient member at the up position.

Claim 30 (Currently amended): The loading ramp of Claim 1 wherein the truck is selected from the group consisting of a pickup truck, a sports utility vehicle, and a van.
